**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `gateway.pool.perRequest` flipped to `true` in config `generation 119`. Each request grabs its own connection from a pool of 20, so the pool stays full. Impact runs `02:14:18Z` to log end `03:59`, 530 of 1228 requests failed. Roll back `dep-4471`.

Two caveats are in the doc. The log is `node-3 of 3`, so other nodes are unchecked. The worker slowdown is separate and still unexplained.
